title: Amygdalus Persica
text: This remedy is characterized by its action on the digestive system, especially the stomach. It is useful in cases of nausea and vomiting, particularly that related to pregnancy. There is a general feeling of irritation and burning in the stomach. It is also useful in cases of morning sickness. Intense nausea and vomiting. Persistent vomiting. Morning sickness of pregnancy. Irritation and burning in the stomach. Thirst. Distended and tender. Flatulence. Compare: Ipecacuanha; Symphoricarpus; Nux vomica. Tincture to third potency.
